_meta.description: This file contains a serialized version of schema entities for drift.

data.name: idx_tx_external_ref
data.sql: CREATE UNIQUE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_tx_external_ref ON transactions (external_ref) WHERE external_ref IS NOT NULL

sql.sql: CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "accounts" ("created_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "updated_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "deleted_at" TEXT NULL, "version" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1, "device_id" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'local', "dirty" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1 CHECK ("dirty" IN (0, 1)), "id" TEXT NOT NULL, "name" TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(LENGTH("name") > 0), "type" TEXT NOT NULL CHECK("type" IN ('cash', 'checking', 'savings', 'digital_wallet', 'investment', 'other')), "currency" TEXT NOT NULL, "opening_balance_cents" INTEGER NOT NULL, "opening_date" TEXT NOT NULL, "color" TEXT NOT NULL, "archived" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("archived" IN (0, 1)), "include_in_availability" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1 CHECK ("include_in_availability" IN (0, 1)), "sort_order" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "categories" ("created_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "updated_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "deleted_at" TEXT NULL, "version" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1, "device_id" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'local', "dirty" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1 CHECK ("dirty" IN (0, 1)), "id" TEXT NOT NULL, "name" TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(LENGTH("name") > 0), "kind" TEXT NOT NULL CHECK("kind" IN ('income', 'expense')), "icon" TEXT NOT NULL, "color" TEXT NOT NULL, "parent_id" TEXT NULL REFERENCES categories (id), "archived" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("archived" IN (0, 1)), "sort_order" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "tags" ("created_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "updated_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "deleted_at" TEXT NULL, "version" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1, "device_id" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'local', "dirty" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1 CHECK ("dirty" IN (0, 1)), "id" TEXT NOT NULL, "name" TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(LENGTH("name") > 0), "color" TEXT NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "credit_cards" ("created_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "updated_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "deleted_at" TEXT NULL, "version" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1, "device_id" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'local', "dirty" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1 CHECK ("dirty" IN (0, 1)), "id" TEXT NOT NULL, "name" TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(LENGTH("name") > 0), "brand" TEXT NULL, "limit_cents" INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK("limit_cents" >= 0), "closing_day" INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK("closing_day" BETWEEN 1 AND 31), "due_day" INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK("due_day" BETWEEN 1 AND 31), "default_payment_account_id" TEXT NULL REFERENCES accounts (id), "color" TEXT NOT NULL, "archived" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("archived" IN (0, 1)), "currency" TEXT NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "goals" ("created_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "updated_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "deleted_at" TEXT NULL, "version" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1, "device_id" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'local', "dirty" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1 CHECK ("dirty" IN (0, 1)), "id" TEXT NOT NULL, "name" TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(LENGTH("name") > 0), "kind" TEXT NOT NULL, "target_cents" INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK("target_cents" >= 0), "target_date" TEXT NULL, "account_id" TEXT NULL REFERENCES accounts (id), "reserved" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1 CHECK ("reserved" IN (0, 1)), "color" TEXT NOT NULL, "archived" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("archived" IN (0, 1)), PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "loans" ("created_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "updated_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "deleted_at" TEXT NULL, "version" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1, "device_id" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'local', "dirty" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1 CHECK ("dirty" IN (0, 1)), "id" TEXT NOT NULL, "name" TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(LENGTH("name") > 0), "lender" TEXT NULL, "principal_cents" INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK("principal_cents" >= 0), "monthly_rate_percent" REAL NOT NULL CHECK("monthly_rate_percent" >= 0.0), "term_months" INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK("term_months" >= 0), "system" TEXT NOT NULL CHECK("system" IN ('price', 'sac', 'american', 'bullet', 'free')), "first_due_date" TEXT NOT NULL, "monthly_fee_cents" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "upfront_fees_cents" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "account_id" TEXT NULL REFERENCES accounts (id), "archived" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("archived" IN (0, 1)), "direction" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'borrowed' CHECK("direction" IN ('borrowed', 'lent')), "interest_mode" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'none' CHECK("interest_mode" IN ('none', 'simple', 'compound')), "rate_period" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'month' CHECK("rate_period" IN ('month', 'year')), "rate_kind" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'effective' CHECK("rate_kind" IN ('effective', 'nominal')), "rate_input_percent" REAL NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "transactions" ("created_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "updated_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "deleted_at" TEXT NULL, "version" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1, "device_id" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'local', "dirty" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1 CHECK ("dirty" IN (0, 1)), "id" TEXT NOT NULL, "kind" TEXT NOT NULL CHECK("kind" IN ('income', 'expense', 'transfer', 'card_purchase', 'card_payment', 'goal_deposit', 'goal_withdrawal', 'loan_disbursement', 'loan_payment', 'balance_adjustment', 'card_refund')), "amount_cents" INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK("amount_cents" >= 0), "currency" TEXT NOT NULL, "date" TEXT NOT NULL, "description" TEXT NOT NULL, "category_id" TEXT NULL REFERENCES categories (id), "account_id" TEXT NULL REFERENCES accounts (id), "to_account_id" TEXT NULL REFERENCES accounts (id), "card_id" TEXT NULL REFERENCES credit_cards (id), "goal_id" TEXT NULL REFERENCES goals (id), "loan_id" TEXT NULL REFERENCES loans (id), "status" TEXT NOT NULL CHECK("status" IN ('planned', 'settled', 'partially_paid', 'cancelled')), "paid_cents" INTEGER NULL CHECK("paid_cents" IS NULL OR "paid_cents" >= 0), "settled_date" TEXT NULL, "due_date" TEXT NULL, "installment_number" INTEGER NULL, "installment_of" INTEGER NULL, "installment_group_id" TEXT NULL, "series_id" TEXT NULL, "transfer_group_id" TEXT NULL, "invoice_month" TEXT NULL, "notes" TEXT NULL, "merchant" TEXT NULL, "external_ref" TEXT NULL, "refund_of_id" TEXT NULL REFERENCES transactions (id), PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "transaction_tags" ("transaction_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES transactions (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, "tag_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES tags (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, "position" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, PRIMARY KEY ("transaction_id", "tag_id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "attachments" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "transaction_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES transactions (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, "file_name" TEXT NOT NULL, "mime_type" TEXT NOT NULL, "size_bytes" INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK("size_bytes" BETWEEN 0 AND 10485760), "sha256" TEXT NOT NULL, "data" BLOB NOT NULL, "created_at" TEXT NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "budgets" ("created_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "updated_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "deleted_at" TEXT NULL, "version" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1, "device_id" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'local', "dirty" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1 CHECK ("dirty" IN (0, 1)), "id" TEXT NOT NULL, "category_id" TEXT NULL REFERENCES categories (id), "limit_cents" INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK("limit_cents" >= 0), "month" TEXT NULL, "rollover" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("rollover" IN (0, 1)), "valid_from" TEXT NULL, "valid_until" TEXT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "recurrence_rules" ("created_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "updated_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "deleted_at" TEXT NULL, "version" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1, "device_id" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'local', "dirty" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1 CHECK ("dirty" IN (0, 1)), "id" TEXT NOT NULL, "frequency" TEXT NOT NULL CHECK("frequency" IN ('daily', 'weekly', 'biweekly', 'monthly', 'bimonthly', 'quarterly', 'semiannual', 'yearly')), "anchor_day" INTEGER NULL, "start_date" TEXT NOT NULL, "end_date" TEXT NULL, "count" INTEGER NULL, "template_transaction_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES transactions (id), "last_generated" TEXT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "shopping_lists" ("created_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "updated_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "deleted_at" TEXT NULL, "version" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1, "device_id" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'local', "dirty" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1 CHECK ("dirty" IN (0, 1)), "id" TEXT NOT NULL, "name" TEXT NOT NULL, "store" TEXT NULL, "budget_cents" INTEGER NULL, "archived" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("archived" IN (0, 1)), "last_completed_at" TEXT NULL, "share_token" TEXT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "shopping_list_items" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "list_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES shopping_lists (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, "name" TEXT NOT NULL, "brand" TEXT NULL, "category" TEXT NULL, "unit" TEXT NOT NULL, "quantity" REAL NOT NULL CHECK("quantity" >= 0.0), "estimated_unit_price_cents" INTEGER NULL, "estimate_source" TEXT NULL, "product_id" TEXT NULL, "barcode" TEXT NULL, "checked" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("checked" IN (0, 1)), "note" TEXT NULL, "sort_order" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "products" ("created_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "updated_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "deleted_at" TEXT NULL, "version" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1, "device_id" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'local', "dirty" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1 CHECK ("dirty" IN (0, 1)), "id" TEXT NOT NULL, "name" TEXT NOT NULL, "brand" TEXT NULL, "barcode" TEXT NULL, "default_unit" TEXT NOT NULL, "presentation_quantity" REAL NULL, "presentation_unit" TEXT NULL, "category" TEXT NULL, "favorite" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("favorite" IN (0, 1)), PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "product_internal_codes" ("product_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES products (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, "store" TEXT NOT NULL, "code" TEXT NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("product_id", "store", "code"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "price_observations" ("created_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "updated_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "deleted_at" TEXT NULL, "version" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1, "device_id" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'local', "dirty" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1 CHECK ("dirty" IN (0, 1)), "id" TEXT NOT NULL, "product_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES products (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, "store" TEXT NULL, "unit" TEXT NOT NULL, "unit_price_cents" INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK("unit_price_cents" >= 0), "observed_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "source" TEXT NOT NULL, "session_id" TEXT NULL, "promo" INTEGER NULL CHECK ("promo" IN (0, 1)), PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "shopping_sessions" ("created_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "updated_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "deleted_at" TEXT NULL, "version" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1, "device_id" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'local', "dirty" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1 CHECK ("dirty" IN (0, 1)), "id" TEXT NOT NULL, "store" TEXT NULL, "list_id" TEXT NULL, "budget_cents" INTEGER NULL, "status" TEXT NOT NULL CHECK("status" IN ('active', 'finished', 'abandoned')), "started_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "finished_at" TEXT NULL, "transaction_id" TEXT NULL, "receipt_access_key" TEXT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "shopping_session_lines" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "session_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES shopping_sessions (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, "position" INTEGER NOT NULL, "product_id" TEXT NULL, "name" TEXT NOT NULL, "brand" TEXT NULL, "barcode" TEXT NULL, "unit" TEXT NOT NULL, "quantity" REAL NOT NULL CHECK("quantity" >= 0.0), "unit_price_cents" INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK("unit_price_cents" >= 0), "discount_cents" INTEGER NULL, "discount_percent" REAL NULL, "promo_take" INTEGER NULL, "promo_pay" INTEGER NULL, "price_source" TEXT NOT NULL, "confidence" REAL NULL, "list_item_id" TEXT NULL, "checked" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("checked" IN (0, 1)), "note" TEXT NULL, "advertised_price_cents" INTEGER NULL, "wholesale_price_cents" INTEGER NULL, "wholesale_min_quantity" INTEGER NULL, "charged_unit_price_cents" INTEGER NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "shopping_session_events" ("seq" INTEGER NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, "session_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES shopping_sessions (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, "at" TEXT NOT NULL, "type" TEXT NOT NULL, "line_id" TEXT NULL, "detail" TEXT NULL);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "shopping_evidence" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "session_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES shopping_sessions (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, "line_id" TEXT NULL, "role" TEXT NOT NULL CHECK("role" IN ('label', 'product', 'receipt', 'other')), "mime_type" TEXT NOT NULL, "size_bytes" INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK("size_bytes" BETWEEN 0 AND 8388608), "sha256" TEXT NOT NULL, "width" INTEGER NULL, "height" INTEGER NULL, "data" BLOB NOT NULL, "captured_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "ocr_json" TEXT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "shopping_receipt_lines" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "session_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES shopping_sessions (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, "position" INTEGER NOT NULL, "raw_text" TEXT NOT NULL, "description" TEXT NOT NULL, "quantity" REAL NOT NULL, "unit" TEXT NOT NULL, "unit_price_cents" INTEGER NULL, "total_cents" INTEGER NOT NULL, "code" TEXT NULL, "matched_line_id" TEXT NULL, "match_status" TEXT NOT NULL CHECK("match_status" IN ('equal', 'divergent', 'suspected', 'confirmed', 'unmatched')), "match_score" REAL NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "kv" ("key" TEXT NOT NULL, "json" TEXT NOT NULL, "updated_at" TEXT NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("key"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "change_log_entries" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "entity_type" TEXT NOT NULL, "entity_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "op" TEXT NOT NULL CHECK("op" IN ('upsert', 'delete', 'restore')), "payload" TEXT NULL, "version" INTEGER NOT NULL, "device_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "at" TEXT NOT NULL, "synced" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("synced" IN (0, 1)), PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "conflicts" ("entity_type" TEXT NOT NULL, "entity_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "field" TEXT NOT NULL, "local_json" TEXT NOT NULL, "remote_json" TEXT NOT NULL, "detected_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "resolved_at" TEXT NULL, "chosen_side" TEXT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("entity_type", "entity_id", "field"));
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "import_reports" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "source" TEXT NOT NULL, "at" TEXT NOT NULL, "report_json" TEXT NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));
CREATE INDEX idx_accounts_deleted ON accounts (deleted_at)
CREATE INDEX idx_categories_parent ON categories (parent_id)
CREATE INDEX idx_tx_date ON transactions (date)
CREATE INDEX idx_tx_kind_date ON transactions (kind, date)
CREATE INDEX idx_tx_account ON transactions (account_id)
CREATE INDEX idx_tx_card_invoice ON transactions (card_id, invoice_month)
CREATE INDEX idx_tx_category ON transactions (category_id)
CREATE INDEX idx_tx_series ON transactions (series_id)
CREATE INDEX idx_tx_deleted ON transactions (deleted_at)
CREATE INDEX idx_tx_due ON transactions (due_date)
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_tx_external_ref ON transactions (external_ref) WHERE external_ref IS NOT NULL
CREATE INDEX idx_tx_tags_tag ON transaction_tags (tag_id)
CREATE INDEX idx_attachments_tx ON attachments (transaction_id)
CREATE INDEX idx_budgets_month ON budgets (month)
CREATE INDEX idx_lists_archived ON shopping_lists (archived)
CREATE INDEX idx_list_items_list ON shopping_list_items (list_id)
CREATE INDEX idx_products_barcode ON products (barcode)
CREATE INDEX idx_obs_product_at ON price_observations (product_id, observed_at)
CREATE INDEX idx_sessions_status ON shopping_sessions (status)
CREATE INDEX idx_sessions_started ON shopping_sessions (started_at)
CREATE INDEX idx_session_lines_session ON shopping_session_lines (session_id)
CREATE INDEX idx_session_events_session ON shopping_session_events (session_id)
CREATE INDEX idx_evidence_session ON shopping_evidence (session_id)
CREATE INDEX idx_receipt_lines_session ON shopping_receipt_lines (session_id)
CREATE INDEX idx_change_log_synced ON change_log_entries (synced, at)
CREATE INDEX idx_change_log_entity ON change_log_entries (entity_type, entity_id)
